Usman dan Fodio moved to Gudu in February 1804 and war was declared on 21 Feb 1804; Kano captured 1807; Sokoto founded by Muhammad Bello in 1809; Gwandu the western seat; emirs appointed by the caliph, with wide autonomy, pledged allegiance and brought tribute each year; the emirates recognised the Sultan of Sokoto's suzerainty; Attahiru I killed in June 1903 (text) or at Burmi on 27 Jul 1903 (infobox).

Re-check on the page before publishing. After Yunfa of Gobir restricted him, Usman made his hijra to Gudu, 30 miles (48 km) to the north-west, in February 1804; Yunfa declared war on him and threatened anyone who joined him on 21 Feb 1804. Usman was proclaimed Amir al-Mu'minin at Gudu. Yunfa won the earlier clash at Tsuntua; Tabkin Kwatto is called the turning point.
